title: PlayerSignals for SkyrimNet
tagline: A little less talking, a little more nodding.
description:
> **⚠️Limited-test beta.** Back up your save and SKSE cosave before installing or updating. Clean removal from an existing save is not guaranteed.
>
> **🙅Does not play animations.** Nods, waves, shrugs and the rest happen in SkyrimNet's narration, not on your character model.

Give your character something to say without saying a word. **PlayerSignals** adds a twelve-slice gesture wheel for SkyrimNet. Look at an NPC, press **Right Alt**, pick a signal, and SkyrimNet narrates your gesture to that NPC, who usually answers in character.

**How it works**
- **Signals** (blue) narrate a gesture such as Greet, Thank you, Yes/Agree or Watch out.
- **Hybrids** (purple), such as Follow me and Wait here, ask the NPC to act as well as narrating the gesture. The NPC can refuse.
- **Actions** (rust) send a request with no narration, such as Stop following.
- **Keys** (teal) press a game key for you, such as opening the journal or the SkyrimNet dashboard.
- **Submenus** (olive) lead to the Social, Attitude and Extras wheels.

Each signal slice has an outer tip called **Openly**: it addresses everyone nearby instead of one NPC. Holding Shift, pressing X on a gamepad, or having nobody under your crosshair does the same. Hybrid actions only run when you address one NPC.

To make sure the NPC you aimed at is the one who answers, a targeted signal is sent as coming from that NPC, so SkyrimNet's event history may show it as from them, to you. Replies are never guaranteed.

**Controls:** mouse, arrow keys or gamepad stick to aim; Enter or A to choose; Esc, Right Alt or B to cancel. Keyboard hints are always shown; gamepad hints appear when a pad is connected.

**Customising:** the wheel layout and all gesture wording live in two JSON files under SKSE/Plugins/PlayerSignals. Edit them, save, and load a save. No recompiling. The download includes a player guide (HTML) and a copy-paste AI helper prompt that drafts these files for you; an optional SkyrimNet agent, PlayerSignals Intent Helper, does the same in the dashboard.

**Requires**
- SkyrimNet (with SkyrimNet.esp loaded)
- SKSE64 and Address Library for SKSE Plugins (VR Address Library on VR)
- Magelight 1.7.1 or newer
- JContainers with Lua support

Install the release ZIP with your mod manager, enable PlayerSignals.esp, and launch through SKSE.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
- New Magelight wheel with twelve slices, replacing the UIExtensions menu (UIExtensions is no longer needed).
- Openly tips, Shift, gamepad X or no target address everyone nearby.
- New slot kinds: hybrids (signal plus action), actions, game keys and raw keys (bundled PlayerSignals.dll).
- Gamepad support: stick aiming, A to choose, B to cancel, X for Openly.
- Faster wheel opening.
- Targeted signals are now answered by the NPC you aimed at, not a bystander.
- Per-slot colours, player guide and AI configuration helper.

UIExtensions is no longer required; Magelight 1.7.1+ and Address Library are. Install the whole package over 0.1.0 (replace it, don't merge) and load a save.
